classes.label: ID
classes.help: Unique snake_case id (2-24 characters); read-only after the first save.

classes.label: Art
classes.help: The class's body (ASSETORG2): a body key, <class> or <class>/<variant> (units/<class>/<variant>/ in the game, kit or engine assets).

classes.label: Default AI role
classes.help: The role units of this class play unless they set their own. Behaviour thresholds are unit fields.

classes.label: Base stats (Lv 1)
classes.help: Every class totals exactly 62 (6-18 per stat): classes differ only in distribution. Empty on a class given as base_shares (its level 1 stats are then computed from the shares).

classes.label: Growth / level
classes.help: Every class gains exactly 5 per level (max 3 per stat); units also get 1 free point per level to spend. Empty on a class given as growth_shares (each level's gain is then computed from the shares).

classes.label: Base shares (Lv 1)
classes.help: Each stat's share of the level 1 budget of 62 (0-1 per stat, totalling 1): the level 1 stats are the shares x 62 rounded by largest remainder (ties: the larger fraction, then stat order). A class gives base_shares and growth_shares instead of base_stats and growth, never both.

classes.label: Growth shares / level
classes.help: Each stat's share of the +5 per level budget (0-1 per stat, totalling 1): the stats at a level are the running total base_shares x 62 + growth_shares x 5 x (level - 1), rounded by largest remainder, so each level hits its budget exactly. Also the weights of the default free-point spend.

classes.label: Gear proficiency
classes.help: Gear type -> {level 1-3, scaling 1.0-2.0}: training level (power, requirement discount, crit, burden, skill gates) and how easy the gear is to wield (Unit Power multiplier). Any unit may wear any gear: gear of a type not listed here is worn untrained (a wield penalty on power, armour and burden), never refused; at least one weapon type.

classes.label: Skill path
classes.help: Skill FAMILY (tier-1 head) -> the unit level it is owned at; its higher tiers open 2 and 4 levels later unless a rank sets unlock_offset. Advanced families need level 5+. No limit on entries; the first 5 by (level, position) are active by default. Basics are never listed (every unit owns them).

classes.label: Origin
classes.help: system: shipped (key fields locked, delete only through SAFE DELETE). user: your own asset. Set by the Forge, never typed.

units.label: Name
units.help: Shown on the field; duplicates in one encounter get a number.

units.label: Class
units.help: One of the base classes: stats, growth, gear proficiency, skill path and default gear come from it.

units.label: Tier
units.help: Scales class-derived HP and attack power (minion 40% / 60% ... boss 170% / 120%). Heroes: 100%.

units.label: Spend points
units.help: 4 + (level - 1) free points, spent exactly (empty = follow the class weights). This is what makes two units of one class differ.

units.label: Stat model
units.help: derived: from class, level, spend and gear. fixed: hand-authored vitals (special units such as the training dummy).

units.label: Initiative
units.help: Fixed-stat initiative (the key keeps its old name speed); the move rate is (value + 2) / 5, from 1 to 4.

units.label: AP pool
units.help: 0 = the encounter's unit AP.

units.label: Strike power
units.help: 0 = weapon power + unit power (unarmed: STR + DEX). Set to override.

units.label: Armor rating
units.help: -1 = gear mitigation + STR / 4. Damage taken is cut by rating / (rating + 50).

units.label: Max Poise
units.help: Rule poise (timeline): -1 = the derived value, 0 = no poise bar (never breaks), 1-200 = a fixed Max Poise.

units.label: Art
units.help: The body (ASSETORG2): a body key, <class> or <class>/<variant>; empty = the class's.

units.label: Palette
units.help: A palette of the body (ASSETORG2): the id of a file <body>/palettes/<id>.json; empty = none.

units.label: Portrait tier
units.help: Unique portrait (hero, npc, elite, boss: portraits/heroes, npcs, elites or bosses/<id>.png) or the body's common one; empty = auto (party hero, npc, an enemy by its base unit's tier).

units.label: Skill level cap
units.help: Explicit AP ceiling for the AI (0 = none: any affordable, unlocked tier). Skill unlocks follow the class path levels.

units.label: Extra skills
units.help: Skills beyond the class path (learned through events).

units.label: Active loadout
units.help: Skill FAMILIES active in combat (max 5 class + 3 extra, basics are free). Empty = default: the first 5 class families reached by level plus the extra skills' families (max 3).

units.label: Deck (timeline)
units.help: Rule deck (timeline): {"active": [families], "passive": [ids], "keystone": [ids], "order": {intent: [families]}, "follow_ups": {opener family: [families of its intent]}}; empty keys = auto. follow_ups (INPUT1 FL1): the fill tries the opener's list first, then the intent's order; an empty list is no list.

units.label: Default intent
units.help: Rule round_intent (timeline): the round intent the unit starts a battle in (empty = none: the first pick is free).

units.label: AI role
units.help: Empty = the class's role.

units.label: Targets
units.help: ROLE: aggressors pick the nearest foe, others the weakest. Rule ai_tactics (HOOKS1 AT1): SOFTEST the lowest armour, TOUGHEST the highest max HP among melee foes (read as ROLE without the rule).

units.label: Flee at HP
units.help: Withdraw at or below this HP fraction (0 = never).

units.label: Preferred skill level
units.help: 0 = highest affordable.

units.label: Status resist %
units.help: 100 = immune.

units.label: Reckless
units.help: AI: never flees or guards, always charges the nearest foe (berserker behaviour).

units.label: Heal allies below HP
units.help: SUPPORT role: heal the most wounded ally at or below this HP fraction (AiProfile.heal_below).

units.label: Tactics
units.help: Rule ai_tactics (HOOKS1 AT2): brace_after_hit (guard after a friend or itself was hit), hold_line (stand by a friend in a choke), flush_cover (aim areas at foes in cover). No repeats.

units.label: Main Hand
units.help: Empty = the class's gear; 'none' = no item.

units.label: Off Hand
units.help: Empty = the class's gear; 'none' = no item.

units.label: Head
units.help: Empty = the class's gear; 'none' = no item.

units.label: Body
units.help: Empty = the class's gear; 'none' = no item.

units.label: Accessory 1
units.help: Empty = the class's gear; 'none' = no item.

units.label: Accessory 2
units.help: Empty = the class's gear; 'none' = no item.

units.label: Battle pouch
units.help: Empty = the class's pouch; ['none'] = no consumables.

units.label: Wears untrained
units.help: Retired (U3.2-S3): any unit may wear any item, an untrained one under the wield penalty, so nothing reads this list. Leave it empty (stored as no key).

units.label: Loot table
units.help: [{"item": "catalog item id", "chance": 3, "count": 1}] (REWARD1): one roll per defeated unit, at most one row drops; chance in % (1-100), chances add up to at most 100, the rest drops nothing. [] = no loot.

units.label: Origin
units.help: system: shipped (key fields locked, delete only through SAFE DELETE). user: your own asset. Set by the Forge, never typed.

skills.label: ID
skills.help: Unique snake_case id used by units and tests. Ranks are <id>, <id>_2, <id>_3.

skills.label: Name
skills.help: Rank names are derived: Mend, Mend II, Mend III (all must fit 32 characters).

skills.label: Kind
skills.help: MOVE / TARGET / STATUS / REST are engine skills; author ATTACK, DEFEND, FOCUS, SUPPORT (heal / cleanse / buff a friendly unit or yourself) or DISENGAGE (jump away from an enemy).

skills.label: AP cost (timeline)
skills.help: Rule ap_cost (timeline): the AP base instead of the level (-1 = unset: the level rule; 0-10).

skills.label: Blocks
skills.help: Timeline length; the effect lands at the end of the last block.

skills.label: Recovery blocks
skills.help: Rule enemy_moves (timeline): blocks an enemy-side unit spends after the impact (0-2; blocks + recovery at most 6). Heroes never book them.

skills.label: Description
skills.help: A template: {name} {ap} {blocks} {power} {dash} {reach} {weapons} {proficiency} {status} {potency} {magnitude} {rounds} {heal} {cleanse} {mitigation} {boost} {jump} {recover} {unlock} {flow} {exploit} {disrupt} {extra}. {{ and }} are literal braces. Each rank renders it with its own numbers.

skills.label: Description template (internal)
skills.help: Flat rows carry the template their description was rendered from.

skills.label: System skill
skills.help: Engine skills the planner inserts itself (Move, Rest, Switch Target, status blocks).

skills.label: Basic skill
skills.help: Owned by every unit from level 1; not counted against the active loadout slots; exactly one rank; not valid in a class path.

skills.label: Learn only
skills.help: Unrestricted hand-built units (tests, sandbox) don't know it unless they learn it; class-derived units get it from skill paths / extra skills as usual.

skills.label: Grade
skills.help: novice, advanced or expert (reserved: no expert skill ships). Advanced and expert class-path steps need unit level 5+ and KNOW can open them earlier (never below level 3).

skills.label: Requires
skills.help: Skill families that must ALL be owned to own or learn this skill; each of a strictly lower grade.

skills.label: Origin
skills.help: system: shipped (key fields locked, delete only through SAFE DELETE). user: your own asset. Set by the Forge, never typed.

skills.label: Stance
skills.help: AUTO: attacks use Offensive.

skills.label: Round intent
skills.help: Rule round_intent (timeline): the intent the skill belongs to; empty = by kind (ATTACK assault, DEFEND guard, SUPPORT and FOCUS support, DISENGAGE maneuver, engine skills neutral). ATTACK may be maneuver, SUPPORT guard (self-only); channel needs a ruleset that lists it.

skills.label: Intent-bound buff
skills.help: Timeline: what the skill grants its own user ends when the user's round intent changes.

skills.label: Unlock offset
skills.help: Levels after the family's unlock level (its class path level) at which THIS rank opens. -1 = derive: 0 / 2 / 4 for ranks 1 / 2 / 3. Rank 1 is always 0.

skills.label: Needs weapon type
skills.help: Empty = any. Otherwise the wielded weapon must be one of these gear types, or the token 'unarmed' (no weapon in that hand; its proficiency is the class's fist level). Needs a proficiency of 1+. Class-derived units only.

skills.label: Needs proficiency
skills.help: Training level in the wielded weapon type required to use the skill (0 = none).

skills.label: Reach min
skills.help: 0 = the unit's default band (attacks: melee 1, ranged 2-3; support: 0-3).

skills.label: Position
skills.help: Maneuver: dash up to the skill's range (Reach max) to this spot by the target and hit from there: flank (beside it) or behind; taken: the nearest diagonal; empty: hit from where it stands

skills.label: Area
skills.help: NONE = single target. PLUS: tile + 4 neighbours, BURST: 3x3, LINE: 3 tiles from the source tile onward, CONE: the source then the 3 tiles across one step on, RING: the 8 tiles around you (Stand), ARC: the source and its two neighbours across the direction (on a diagonal an L back toward you). LINE, CONE and ARC point from your tile to the source, snapped to 4 straight or the exact diagonal directions.

skills.label: Affects
skills.help: Which units the area hits (IR9). "" = the row's default: all for a Field row or a skill that leaves a hazard, enemies for an Assault or Stand row, allies for a Support row; with no round intents (classic) all. The user is never hit.

skills.label: Power x
skills.help: Multiplier on the unit's strike power. 0 = no damage (a debuff-only attack; needs an Inflicts status).

skills.label: Weapon hand
skills.help: main: the main weapon. off: the off-hand weapon, or bare hands (melee, distance 1). both: dual-wield strike (engine pending).

skills.label: Gap-close tiles
skills.help: Lunge: move up to this many tiles to get into reach, then strike. Only offered while the target is out of reach; it is the unit's move for the round (one per round, blocked by root, terrain and units). AP is the skill's level alone.

skills.label: Status potency %
skills.help: Chance = potency - target debuff resistance - passive resistance.

skills.label: Status magnitude
skills.help: Strength of the status (unit and range from the status registry: weaken %, expose/fortify armor points, regen/burn % max HP, poison HP per round).

skills.label: Status rounds
skills.help: How many rounds an inflicted / granted status lasts once active (it starts next round; a DEFEND skill's riposte is active at once and counts the current round).

skills.label: Targets
skills.help: SELF: the caster only. ALLY: a friendly unit other than the caster. ALLY_OR_SELF: either.

skills.label: Heal scales with
skills.help: Heal = heal base + stat x heal per point (SupportRules.heal_amount), never DamageCalculator.

skills.label: Grants
skills.help: SUPPORT: haste (+1 tile per move block) or taunt (enemy AI must target it while reachable), queued for next round. DEFEND: riposte (counters adjacent melee attackers for 50% power), active at once, lost on a stance change; or any support buff (taunt, haste), queued for next round like a support grant.

skills.label: Extra grants
skills.help: BAL5-L: one more buff granted with the main grant, at the same timing (a DEFEND-only buff such as riposte at once, every other buff next round): [{"status": "fortify", "rounds": 2, "magnitude": 6}]. At most 1 entry; a buff other than Grants; rounds 1-3; magnitude inside the status range (0 for statuses without one). Ranks may override the whole list.

skills.label: Cleanses
skills.help: Debuffs removed from the target (active and pending, never buffs): stagger, stun, root, bleed, or the keyword 'all' for every debuff. Empty = none. Combine freely with heal and grants.

skills.label: Mitigation
skills.help: The guard fraction (damage taken x (1 - mitigation)), held from the wind-up start to the round's end and, for a multi-round guard, through its later rounds (S1.2-S4); 0 = no guard. Design defaults (ruleset numbers): guard_common_mitigation 0.35 for a 1-round guard, guard_multi_round_mitigation 0.20 for a multi-round one.

skills.label: Guard rounds
skills.help: Rounds the guard holds (S1.2-S4): 1 = this round only (from the wind-up start to the round's end); 2-5 = a multi-round guard that queues the guard status (Guarded) for its later rounds at the skill's mitigation.

skills.label: Jump tiles
skills.help: Disengage: jump up to this many tiles away from the nearest (or a chosen) enemy. It is the unit's move for the round (first in the sequence, refused when rooted); AP is the skill's level; units can be leapt over, walls cannot.

skills.label: Ends in stance
skills.help: Flow move: after its last block the unit is in this stance for free, so a next action of that stance pays no switch. Empty = the skill's own stance. Leaving Defensive ends riposte, so a riposte DEFEND cannot flow. Set on the family, not per rank.

skills.label: Disrupt
skills.help: STANCE_BREAK: a damaging hit the target survives knocks an Offensive or Defensive target into Tactical (its running guard and riposte end). Not a status: no resist roll. Set on the family, not per rank.

skills.label: Exploit
skills.help: Status payoff: up to 2 entries [{"status": "expose", "power_mult": 1.3}]; against a target with one of these debuffs ACTIVE the skill's power is multiplied by the highest matching power (1.05-2.0). Rule execute (HOOKS1 EX1): one more entry {"hp_below": 1-99, "power_mult"} matches a target at or below that HP share. Set on the family, not per rank.

skills.label: Consume exploited status
skills.help: After the hit, remove the matched active status with the highest multiplier. Needs an exploit status.

skills.label: Stagger
skills.help: Rule poise (timeline): poise taken from each unit the hit damages (0-100).

skills.label: Windup poise
skills.help: Rule poise (timeline): poise the user gains while the action winds up (0-100).

skills.label: Unbreakable windup
skills.help: Rule poise (timeline): while this action winds up the user's poise cannot drop below 1.

skills.label: Sure break
skills.help: Rule poise (timeline): a hit that lands in a windup breaks the target (not an unbreakable or steadfast one). Needs stagger 1+ on every rank.

skills.label: Armour piercing
skills.help: Rule pierce (timeline): the hit skips the armour term (guard and cover still apply).

skills.label: Forced move
skills.help: Rule forced_move (HOOKS1 FM1): {"kind": push | pull, "tiles": 1-3, "from": source | center (needs an area), "when": always | moved | windup, "stop_moves", "collide_mult": 0.0-3.0, "collide_stagger": 0-50, "collide_break"}; moves each unit the skill damaged. {} = none. Set on the family.

skills.label: Leaves hazard
skills.help: Rule ground_hazards (HOOKS1 GH2): {"id": a hazards row, "shape": SKILL (the area's cells) | NONE | PLUS | BURST | LINE | RING | ARC, "at": target | self, "rounds": 0-5 (0 = the row's duration)}. An ATTACK with power 0 and a hazard is a placement. {} = none.

skills.label: Triggers
skills.help: Rule triggers (HOOKS1 8.1): up to 3 rows held while the command runs: [{"on": hit_taken | guarded_hit | ally_hit | evaded | broken, "when": {}, "effects": [{"type": "redirect", "pct": 100}], "limit": round | battle | none}].

skills.label: Riders
skills.help: Rule triggers (HOOKS1 RD1): up to 3 rows run per unit the skill landed on: [{"when": {"other_broken": true}, "effects": [{"type": "guard", "mitigation": 0.5, "blocks": 0}]}] (the trigger effects but redirect; `to` defaults to that unit).

skills.label: Meter costs
skills.help: Rule unit_meters (HOOKS1 UM2): up to 2 [{"meter": a unit_meters row, "delta": -100..100, not 0}] applied at the command's start; a negative delta needs that much in the meter.

skills.label: HP cost
skills.help: Rule hp_cost (HOOKS1 HC1): HP paid at the command's start (never below 1); the planner refuses the skill at or below that HP. 0 = none.

skills.label: Ignores guard
skills.help: Rule ignore_guard (HOOKS1 IG1): the hits skip the guard term (cover stays) and stagger ignores the guard factor.

skills.label: Skill family
skills.help: Derived: the head skill id of a higher rank (empty on rank 1).

skills.label: Rank
skills.help: Derived: 1 for the head skill, 2 / 3 for <id>_2 / <id>_3.

items.label: Type
items.help: Derived from the family (version 2 items).

items.label: Family
items.help: The item family (template): type, hands, slots, base numbers, modifier policy.

items.label: Icon id
items.help: A file items/<folder>/<icon_id>.png in the game, kit or engine assets (ASSETORG2); empty = the family's base icon, then the item type's.

items.label: In starter stash
items.help: Added to the party stash of every encounter and the Gear Dojo.

items.label: Special item
items.help: May exceed the class gear budget; needs a special note.

items.label: Special note
items.help: The trade-off or playstyle that justifies a special item.

items.label: Hand
items.help: Exactly one hand, one of the family's hands; the slot follows it.

items.label: Gear type
items.help: Checked against class proficiencies and weapon masteries.

items.label: Range
items.help: 2+ makes the wielder a ranged unit.

items.label: Off-hand category
items.help: Set for off-hand-only weapons and shields.

items.label: Burden
items.help: Initiative penalty while worn.

items.label: Effects
items.help: Applies while equipped. Allowed: skill_potency (family or group spell/heal), status_potency (1-25), spell_reach (1-2), resist; HOOKS1: trigger {on, when, effects, limit} and forced_move {immune, bonus_tiles}; U3.2-S4: skill {skill} (open while worn, no deck slot) and stat {stat, value, percent, context}; all taken off with the item. [{"type": "skill_potency", "group": "heal", "value": 0.1}]

items.label: Threshold tiers
items.help: Derived from the tier thresholds: [{"stat", "threshold", "bonus_power", "desc"}] (+ when / bonus for extended tiers).

items.label: Modifiers
items.help: Ordered list of {kind, ...}: adjust {field, delta}, stat_bonus {stat, value}, requirement {stat, value}, effect {effect}.

items.label: Tier thresholds
items.help: Up to the family's max tiers: {label, when {stat_at_least | proficiency_at_least | unit_level_at_least}, bonus {power | mitigation | stat_bonuses | effects}, desc}.

items.label: Use reach
items.help: Tiles from the user's planned tile (like skill reach); 0 = self only, -1 = the type default (potion 1, elixir 0, bomb 3).

items.label: Leaves hazard
items.help: Rule ground_hazards (HOOKS1 GH2): {"id": a hazards row, "shape": NONE | PLUS | BURST | LINE | RING | ARC, "at": target | self, "rounds": 0-5} placed at use. {} = none.

items.label: Origin
items.help: system: shipped (key fields locked, delete only through SAFE DELETE). user: your own asset. Set by the Forge, never typed.

passives.label: Deck slot
passives.help: Rule deck (timeline): empty = granted by its source, always on; passive or keystone = applies only while slotted. Classic ignores it.

passives.label: Origin
passives.help: system: shipped (key fields locked, delete only through SAFE DELETE). user: your own asset. Set by the Forge, never typed.

encounters.label: Arena
encounters.help: OPEN: every edge is an exit.

encounters.label: Exit tiles
encounters.help: [[x, y], ...] on the 12x9 grid (CLOSED arenas).

encounters.label: Terrain rows
encounters.help: ENCOUNTER2 R0: [] = the zone's map; else 9 strings of 12 terrain glyphs, row 0 at the top (. floor, , grass, : dirt, o stone, s sand, * snow, ~ shallow water, W deep water, m mud, L lava, # wall, T tree, = bridge, r rubble, f burning ground, p toxic bog, i ice); they replace the zone's terrain, the zone still picks the backdrop and tiles.

encounters.label: Arena hazards
encounters.help: Rule arena_hazards (HOOKS1 AH1): up to 4 [{"id", "name", "cells": [[x, y]] | "columns": [x] | "rows": [y], "rounds": [] (every round), "blocks": [1-6], "effect": {"damage" | "damage_pct", "stagger", "status", "potency", "magnitude", "status_rounds", "push": {"dir", "tiles", "collide_damage"}}, "line"}] striking at the end of those blocks.

encounters.label: AP regen / round
encounters.help: -1 = refill to max each round.

encounters.label: Unit AP
encounters.help: Max AP (and, with Start AP 0, the starting AP) for units without their own pool.

encounters.label: Start AP
encounters.help: Every unit's AP when the battle starts, at most its max (0 = full).

encounters.label: Enemies
encounters.help: The same unit may appear more than once.

encounters.label: Phases
encounters.help: [{"id", "name", "trigger": {"kind": "hp_below", "unit", "pct": 50} or {"kind": "round", "round": 3}, "effects": [{"type": "line", "text"}, {"type": "wave", "units": [], "label"}, {"type": "status", "unit", "status": "fortify", "rounds": 2, "magnitude": 5}, {"type": "ai", "unit", "reckless": true}, {"type": "enrage", "unit", "power": 20}], "pause_autoplay": true}], at most 4 (BOSS1; EncounterPhases). hp_below may add "or_round": N (PACE1); one enrage per encounter, its phase pauses autoplay. {"kind": "arrival", "round": 1, "block": 4}: a reinforcement wave that enters before that block, counts as an enemy from the start and holds one wave effect; at most one, listed first (PHASEFOLD). HOOKS1: an ai effect may set "tactics" (replaces the list) and target_pref SOFTEST or TOUGHEST; {"type": "deck", "unit", "add": [families], "order": {intent: [families]}} changes the unit's deck (rule deck). FX1: {"type": "shake", "preset"} shakes the battle camera (preset jolt, heavy, toll, tremor or quake; at most one per phase; no rule reads it). ENCOUNTER2-C: a round trigger may add "block" (0 = the round start, 1 to total_blocks = that block's start; round 1 fires before round 1 is planned); {"kind": "downed", "unit", "count": 1} is due once the count-th unit of the name is down and {"kind": "broken", "unit"} once one breaks (rule poise), each firing at the next block start or round start; the unit name is an encounter ref, "party" or "party:<id>". {"type": "talk", "dialogue", "speaker"} opens a world dialogue tree over the battle: world encounters only, at most one per phase; no rule reads it.

encounters.label: Scripted rounds
encounters.help: ENCOUNTER2-C scripted rounds (rule round_intent; [] = none): at most 3 [{"round": N (1..max_rounds, once), "lock": true (planned and confirmed at the round start, the input locked; false = a guided round: the enemies' entries fixed, the party's become first picks), "others": "auto" | "rest" (members with no entry: their auto plan, or Rest), "banner" (at most 40 characters), "entries": [{"unit": ref | ref#n | party:<id> | party#n, "target": "self" | a unit | [x, y], "picks": 1-4 of {"skill": family, "kind"?}, {"item": id} (party only), "rest", {"move": [x, y]} (first only), {"step_after": [x, y]}, "fill": "auto" | "rest"}] (1-16, one per unit)}]. Picked by the player's pick rules (AP, range, moves); a script never forces a hit; an entry that cannot be planned logs a Script cell and its unit plays its own round. A catalog encounter plays it only under the timeline ruleset.

encounters.label: Pace
encounters.help: Round target tier (PACE1): mob ~3, elite ~5, boss 7-9. auto = boss when any enemy (waves included) is tier boss, else elite when any is elite, else mob (EncounterPhases.pace_of).

encounters.label: Objective
encounters.help: rout: defeat every enemy; hold: keep the objective tiles; escape: get heroes out by an exit; slay: defeat one unit (OBJ1).

encounters.label: Objective tiles
encounters.help: [[x, y], ...] walkable, not exits; [] = the ring [[5, 4], [6, 4]].

encounters.label: Hold rounds
encounters.help: Round ends held to win (1..max rounds).

encounters.label: Slay target
encounters.help: A unit id from Enemies.

encounters.label: Heroes out
encounters.help: Heroes that must leave by an exit.

encounters.label: Objective text
encounters.help: At most 80 characters; empty = generated from the objective.

encounters.label: Unkillable
encounters.help: ENCOUNTER2 S1: enemies (or phase-wave units) damage never takes below 1 HP; the first time it would, the log says "<name> will not fall here." (once per unit). Rout cannot end the fight while one stands.

encounters.label: Timeout outcome
encounters.help: ENCOUNTER2 S2: the verdict when the last round ends with none (fled = today's rule).

encounters.label: Stay behind
encounters.help: ENCOUNTER2 3 (escape only; {} = none): {"mode": "hold" | "stand", "tiles": [[x, y]] (hold: 1-2 walkable tiles, not exits; stand: none), "tiles_label": "the line" (1-24 characters), "fallback": "any" | "none" (hold), "pick_default": "highest_hp" | "first" (hold), "exits_open": "always" | "after_stand" (stand), "stand_hp_pct": 30 (stand, 1-100), "stand_statuses": [{"status": "taunt", "rounds": 5}] (at most 3, rounds 1-10), "stand_line", "result_line" (at most 160 characters, {name} the only token)}. Hold: the player picks who holds the tiles before round 1; the exits open while the holder holds; won when enough heroes are out and every other one is out, down or holding.

encounters.label: Deployment
encounters.help: standard: side against side; ambush: enemies on both sides; centre: the party holds the middle.

encounters.label: Morale
encounters.help: Enemy groups break and surrender as they lose members, take crits or lose their leader (MORALE1). Off = they fight to the last.

encounters.label: Morale break
encounters.help: 0..90: a group is Broken at or below this value (groups start at 100).

encounters.label: Morale leader
encounters.help: A unit id from Enemies; empty = the first boss or elite enemy, else none.

encounters.label: Morale groups
encounters.help: [[enemy index, ...], ...]; every enemy in exactly one group; [] = all enemies are one group.

encounters.label: Morale text
encounters.help: At most 80 characters; empty = the generated break line.

encounters.label: Purse
encounters.help: {"gold_min": 0, "gold_max": gold_min, "once": true} (PURSE1, REWARD1): gold 0..500, split among the enemies by kill weight and paid per defeated enemy on any outcome; once = each enemy's share pays once per save. {} = no purse.

encounters.label: Guests
encounters.help: At most 2 extra party-side units; no XP, never saved.

encounters.label: Protect
encounters.help: Guests that must survive (each must be in Guests).

encounters.label: Origin
encounters.help: system: shipped (key fields locked, delete only through SAFE DELETE). user: your own asset. Set by the Forge, never typed.

terrain.label: ID
terrain.help: A terrain type id (Terrain.ids(): floor, grass, ... burning_ground, toxic_bog, ice).

terrain.label: Walkable
terrain.help: Units can stand on and move through the tile. A row without it takes its type's fallback (deep_water, lava, wall and tree block; every other type is walkable).

terrain.label: Stops forced moves
terrain.help: A shove or pull cannot enter the tile and collides before it. A row without it takes not walkable.

terrain.label: Move cost
terrain.help: Cost of entering a tile (walkable types 1-3; blocked types ignore it).

terrain.label: Cover
terrain.help: Guard share (0.0-0.5) a ranged hit loses on this tile, or behind it when the tile blocks movement.

terrain.label: Hazard status
terrain.help: A debuff rolled on units entering or standing on the tile (walkable types only).

terrain.label: Hazard magnitude
terrain.help: Inside the status's registry range (0 when it has none).

terrain.label: Hazard trigger
terrain.help: enter: when a move enters the tile; round_end: standing on it at round end; both.

terrain.label: Origin
terrain.help: system: shipped (key fields locked, delete only through SAFE DELETE). user: your own asset. Set by the Forge, never typed.

item_families.label: ID
item_families.help: A gear family (WEAPON, SHIELD, ARMOR) is named after its gear token (Proficiency.gear_types()).

item_families.label: Hands
item_families.help: One category: main hands (main_1h, main_2h; damage weapons) or exactly off (support items).

item_families.label: Off-hand category
item_families.help: Derived: the family id of an off-hand family (shield, orb, tome).

item_families.label: Slots
item_families.help: Armor: HEAD, BODY; accessories: ACCESSORY_1, ACCESSORY_2. Weapons and shields derive the slot from the hand.

item_families.label: Scaling stats
item_families.help: The first is the default of new items.

item_families.label: Base numbers
item_families.help: Per hand ("none" without hands): the five numbers every item of the hand starts from (power, range, block cost, burden, mitigation).

item_families.label: Soft bands
item_families.help: Per hand, per number {min, max}, plus bonus_value {min, max} (GearBudget value of stat bonuses and effects). Outside = warning.

item_families.label: Engine rules
item_families.help: Closed list (code-owned): focus, always_ranged, shield, spell_source.

item_families.label: Level 2 bonus
item_families.help: U3 Level 2 (Adept): {} = none, or one of {"crit": 1-10} (crit chance points while an item of this family is worn at proficiency 2+) or {"burden": 1-3} (taken off each such item's burden); on top of the per-level crit and burden of training. WEAPON, SHIELD and ARMOR families only.

item_families.label: Level 3 passive
item_families.help: U3 Level 3 (Master): an always-on passive (slot "") applied while an item of this family is worn at proficiency 3, as the item's effects (no unlock, foresight, stagger_taken, meter or proficiency); taken off with the item. Empty = none. WEAPON, SHIELD and ARMOR families only.

item_families.label: Art
item_families.help: The icon folder (ASSETORG2): items/<art>/ (empty = the family id); its base.png is the family's icon.

derived_stats.label: ID
derived_stats.help: Unique snake_case id (2-24 characters, a letter first): the name formulas, gear, passives and rules use. Not a base stat (any case), not level, not a formula function.

derived_stats.label: Label
derived_stats.help: Table header (at most 16 characters, unique among the derived stats); empty = the name.

derived_stats.label: Formula
derived_stats.help: Arithmetic over the base stats (STR DEX INT CONS PERC KNOW), level, other derived stat ids and this row's constants: + - * / ( ), min, max, clamp, floor, ceil, round. Example: base + KNOW * per_know + CONS * per_cons. No cycles between rows.

derived_stats.label: Constants
derived_stats.help: {"base": 0, "per_know": 2}: names the formula may use (not a base stat, level or a derived stat id); finite numbers up to 1000000 in size.

derived_stats.label: Min
derived_stats.help: Lowest value (min <= max). A 0-100 row can serve as a resist.

derived_stats.label: Status modifiers
derived_stats.help: [{"status": "weaken", "flat": -5, "percent": 0.0}]: added while the status is active on the unit; flat a whole number -100..100, percent -1.0..1.0, not both 0; one entry per status.

derived_stats.label: Rulesets
derived_stats.help: The rulesets (ruleset row ids) the stat exists in; empty = every ruleset. Elsewhere no rule and no screen sees it.

derived_stats.label: Show on
derived_stats.help: The screens that list it: party, dojo, battle (inspect).

derived_stats.label: Order
derived_stats.help: Display order among the derived stats; ties keep the loaded order.

derived_stats.label: Origin
derived_stats.help: system: shipped (key fields locked, delete only through SAFE DELETE). user: your own asset. Set by the Forge, never typed.

rulesets.label: ID
rulesets.help: Unique snake_case id (2-24 characters); read-only after the first save. classic is the default ruleset (the legacy rules: no rules, diagonal melee none).

rulesets.label: Rules
rulesets.help: The rules on under this ruleset, no repeats. Options (round_intent, enemy_moves, deck, field_intent, which needs round_intent) never run in classic; extensions (poise, ap_cost, pierce, reach, flank, plan_badges and HOOKS1's forced_move, ground_hazards, arena_hazards, triggers, unit_meters, hp_cost, ignore_guard, ai_tactics, execute) are inert without data and switch one by one in the Combat Arena and the sim.

rulesets.label: Intents
rulesets.help: The round intents a member may pick: at least one, no repeats; needs round_intent in Rules. channel is reserved for Act 2.

rulesets.label: Basics
rulesets.help: Skill families every unit may use without a deck slot (needed with deck), no repeats: each of a listed intent or neutral (its round intent, else its kind's).

rulesets.label: Poise stat
rulesets.help: The derived stat that is Max Poise (needed with poise).

rulesets.label: Diagonal melee
rulesets.help: Diagonal melee: none, Maneuver skills only, or every melee attack

rulesets.label: Protected flank cost
rulesets.help: What a Maneuver whose flank is protected pays

rulesets.label: Protected flank AP
rulesets.help: The AP a protected flank pays with fixed (at most the skill's cost).

rulesets.label: Rest AP
rulesets.help: When a landed Rest block returns its AP: on_use (as it lands, the skill's recover AP) or round_end (at the round's end, Rest AP per block up to the Rest AP cap); empty = by the rules: round_end with round_intent, else on_use.

rulesets.label: Chase
rulesets.help: Which planned skills follow their target up to 1 tile when it moves: classic (an attack on a unit unless it comes after a move to a chosen tile; Support never) or every_skill (every attack on a unit and every Support skill on an ally); area skills never chase; empty = by the rules: every_skill with round_intent, else classic.

rulesets.label: Root stops a chase
rulesets.help: on: a rooted unit does not chase; empty = by the rules: on with round_intent, else off.

rulesets.label: Switch Target step
rulesets.help: on: an attack on another unit than the locked one inserts a Switch Target step first; off: the attack targets its unit and takes the lock; empty = by the rules: off with round_intent, else on.

rulesets.label: Stances
rulesets.help: on: the classic stances run (stance switches and their AP, the matchup, stance breaks); empty = by the rules: off with round_intent, else on.

rulesets.label: Attack lock
rulesets.help: Which attacks on a unit commit to their target's tile when their wind-up starts, after any chase or dash, and miss if it has left that tile at impact (a dodge, AP spent): none (they hit while it is in reach at impact), melee (bands starting next to the target and ending within 2 tiles, reach weapons and skills with a position included), or all (ranged too). Area attacks keep their tiles fixed at planning under every value.

rulesets.label: Move blocks after a skill
rulesets.help: The most move blocks of a Move after a skill (a Move as the opener keeps its two); read with round_intent.

rulesets.label: Item AP
rulesets.help: The AP a consumable use costs (AP debt allowed); a unit that pays no AP pays nothing. Classic keeps 1; the timeline row sets 0 (A1.2-S1).

portrait_cues.label: ID
portrait_cues.help: Unique snake_case id (2-32 characters, a letter first).

portrait_cues.label: Trigger
portrait_cues.help: event: a battle event fires the row once. status, condition, hp, derived, down, unspent: a state that holds the row while it is true (unspent: a party member has unspent points; never in battle). (meter is reserved for unit meters: CAMPAIGN1-DOC.)

portrait_cues.label: Event
portrait_cues.help: event rows only (required): hit, crit, guard_hit (hit while guarding), heal, break; battle_start (every living unit, at the battle's first frame), ambush (the player side, with battle_start in an ambush deployment), round_start (every living unit as a round starts; not under the round intent rule), skill (the acting unit as its skill winds up; see Min level), ally_down (the living units of a side one of theirs went down on), victory (the player side, on the winning step).

portrait_cues.label: Min level
portrait_cues.help: skill event rows only: 0-9, the least skill level that fires the row (0 = any skill). Else 0.

portrait_cues.label: Status
portrait_cues.help: status rows only (required): a status id; the row holds while the unit has the status.

portrait_cues.label: Condition
portrait_cues.help: condition rows only (required): a member condition id (wounded); 1-24 of a-z and _.

portrait_cues.label: Derived stat
portrait_cues.help: derived rows only (required): a derived stat id.

portrait_cues.label: Below
portrait_cues.help: hp rows: 1-100, holds while HP is below this percent of the max. derived rows: 1-100, holds while the stat is below this value. Else 0.

portrait_cues.label: Drop %
portrait_cues.help: derived rows only: 1-100, holds while the stat is at least this percent below its value without statuses. A derived row sets exactly one of Below and Drop %.

portrait_cues.label: Effect
portrait_cues.help: The portrait effect (the engine's portrait layer): reactions flash, jolt; states desaturate, tint, fade, still; overlays glow, veins, eye_glow, ash, smoke; face picks an expression frame.

portrait_cues.label: Duration ms
portrait_cues.help: event rows: flash 60-1000 (required); jolt 0 (the preset's) or 60-600; other effects 100-3000 (required). State rows: 0 (they hold).

portrait_cues.label: Colour
portrait_cues.help: "" (the effect's default) or #rrggbb; only on flash, tint, glow, veins, eye_glow, ash, smoke.

portrait_cues.label: Expression
portrait_cues.help: face only (required): a face of portrait_expressions (or neutral).

portrait_cues.label: Priority
portrait_cues.help: 0-100, face only: the highest face row wins (ties: the latest started).

portrait_cues.label: Surfaces
portrait_cues.help: Where the row applies: dialogue, roster, panel, timeline; empty = everywhere.

portrait_cues.label: Rulesets
portrait_cues.help: The rulesets (ruleset row ids) the row applies in; empty = every ruleset.

portrait_cues.label: Origin
portrait_cues.help: system: shipped (key fields locked, delete only through SAFE DELETE). user: your own asset. Set by the Forge, never typed.

portrait_expressions.label: Expression
portrait_expressions.help: The face the row draws for (2-24 characters of a-z, 0-9 and _, a letter first): the game's faces are neutral, then these ids in file order (no rows: neutral, hurt, angry, afraid). neutral may have a row with motion fields only (the plain face's motion). The effects draw while a face cue holds the face.

portrait_expressions.label: Tint
portrait_expressions.help: "" (no tint) or #rrggbb: the colour laid over the portrait's face box (the sidecar's face box, else one taken from its eye boxes; a portrait with neither has no tint).

portrait_expressions.label: Tint strength
portrait_expressions.help: 0.05-1.0: how far the face box moves toward the tint (full in its middle, softening to its edge).

portrait_expressions.label: Tint ms
portrait_expressions.help: 0: the tint holds while the expression holds (easing in). 60-3000: it starts full and fades out over that many ms (a flash). Needs a tint.

portrait_expressions.label: Mark
portrait_expressions.help: "" (none), vein (the anger mark) or sweat (a drop): a small code-drawn pixel shape. Not drawn on the smallest portraits.

portrait_expressions.label: Mark colour
portrait_expressions.help: "" (the mark's default) or #rrggbb. Needs a mark.

portrait_expressions.label: Mark box
portrait_expressions.help: The box the mark's anchor is in: face (the face box) or eyes (the eye boxes together).

portrait_expressions.label: Mark x
portrait_expressions.help: -1.0-2.0: the mark's centre across its box (0 the left edge, 1 the right; outside the box allowed, as a temple beside the face).

portrait_expressions.label: Mark y
portrait_expressions.help: -1.0-2.0: the mark's centre down its box (0 the top edge, 1 the bottom).

portrait_expressions.label: Mark size
portrait_expressions.help: 0.04-0.3: the mark's width as a share of the portrait's side (never under the shape's own pixels).

portrait_expressions.label: Mark pulse ms
portrait_expressions.help: 0: steady. 300-4000: the mark pulses (grows and brightens) with that period; steady under reduce motion. Needs a mark.

portrait_expressions.label: Shake px
portrait_expressions.help: 0-4: a shake of the whole portrait when the expression starts (none under reduce motion or on the smallest portraits).

portrait_expressions.label: Shake ms
portrait_expressions.help: 60-600 with a shake (how long it lasts), else 0.

portrait_expressions.label: Breath amp
portrait_expressions.help: 0-4.0: the breath's depth in px at a 240 px portrait (the inner picture stretches up from its bottom edge; 2.88 is the plain breath, 0 none). Full-size portraits only; none under reduce motion.

portrait_expressions.label: Breath ms
portrait_expressions.help: 800-8000: one breath's length (each portrait varies it by up to 10 %).

portrait_expressions.label: Breath in
portrait_expressions.help: 0.2-0.8: the share of a breath spent breathing in (0.5 even; lower is a quick in and a long out).

portrait_expressions.label: Breath jitter
portrait_expressions.help: 0-0.5: how unevenly the breaths come (each breath's length and depth vary by up to this share).

portrait_expressions.label: Lean px
portrait_expressions.help: -3 to 3: the picture leans this many px with each breath (positive toward the right). Needs a breath.

portrait_expressions.label: Bob px
portrait_expressions.help: 0-3: a light bounce up of this many px.

portrait_expressions.label: Bob ms
portrait_expressions.help: 300-3000 with a bob (one bounce's length), else 0.

portrait_expressions.label: Enter dy
portrait_expressions.help: -3 to 3: a move when the face starts (negative up, as a hop or a jolt), back to rest over Enter ms.

portrait_expressions.label: Enter stretch
portrait_expressions.help: -3 to 3: a stretch when the face starts (negative squeezes, as a wince), back over Enter ms.

portrait_expressions.label: Enter ms
portrait_expressions.help: 60-1200 with an entry move (Enter dy or Enter stretch), else 0. The breath waits until it ends.

portrait_expressions.label: Rest dy
portrait_expressions.help: -3 to 3: a held offset while the face shows (negative lifts, positive sinks).

portrait_expressions.label: Rest ms
portrait_expressions.help: 0-3000: how long the held offset takes to reach (0 at once); 0 without one.

portrait_expressions.label: Settle ms
portrait_expressions.help: 0-4000: after the entry move the breath, lean and bob grow back over this long (0 at once).

portrait_expressions.label: Shiver px
portrait_expressions.help: 0-2: bursts of jitter of this many px.

portrait_expressions.label: Shiver ms
portrait_expressions.help: 80-1000 with a shiver (one burst's length), else 0.

portrait_expressions.label: Shiver gap ms
portrait_expressions.help: 200-8000 with a shiver (about this long between bursts), else 0.

portrait_expressions.label: Blink
portrait_expressions.help: Off: no blinks while the face shows (a face whose eyes are shut or wide).

portrait_expressions.label: Tint breath
portrait_expressions.help: 0-1.0: the tint pulses with the breath by this share (steady under reduce motion and on the smallest portraits). Needs a tint and a breath.

hazards.label: Damage
hazards.help: Flat damage, through guard, not armour.

hazards.label: Cover

hazards.label: Move cost

hazards.label: Affects
hazards.help: Whom it affects, by the placer's side.

hazards.label: Trap
hazards.help: Springs on the first affected unit that enters: stops its move there, then is gone.

hazards.label: Hidden
hazards.help: Not drawn for and not seen by the other side (needs affects foes).

hazards.label: Stops moves
hazards.help: A sprung trap cancels the unit's later moves this round.

hazards.label: Duration
hazards.help: Rounds it lasts when the placement sets none.

hazards.label: Glyph

unit_meters.help: Up to 3 round-end rows [{"delta": -50..50, "unless_gained", "if_guarded"}], in order.

unit_meters.label: Meter skills

unit_meters.label: Triggers

world.label: Ruleset
world.help: The combat rules of this world's battles: a ruleset row id (classic, timeline, ...). Empty = the nearest parent world's, else classic.

world.label: Plan reveal flag
world.help: A game-state flag key (a-z, 0-9, _ and ., as world.flag); while it is set, enemy plans are shown in full. Empty = never.

world.label: Campaign
world.help: {"start_act": 0..9, "act_saves": true} (CAMPAIGN1): set = the world runs a campaign (meters, day clock, checkpoints, triggers, run over). {} = none (the nearest parent world's).

world.label: Purse names
world.help: {"currency": {name, icon, tip}, "upkeep": {name, short, icon, tip, per_day 0..5, at_zero: {road_pct 100..300, start_ap -5..0}}} (CAMPAIGN1 P1-P3): names 1-24 characters. {} = Gold and Supplies (the nearest parent world's).

world.label: Rest rule
world.help: {"days": 0..3, "cost": 0..10, "where": nodes | rest_places | none, "on_enter": true, "needs_upkeep": true} (CAMPAIGN1 R1). {} = Camp on any node for 3 supplies, no days, a free heal on entering a rest place.

world.label: Defeat rule
world.help: {"mode": wake | retreat, "to": location, "days": 0..3} (CAMPAIGN1 R4): retreat moves the party to the location after a lost battle and passes the days. {} = wake (heal and wake at the last rest place).

world.label: Travel modes
world.help: {"default": a mode id (the first mode's when empty), "modes": [at most 4 {"id", "name" 1-24, "tip" 0-240, "days" 0..5 more per leg, "road_pct" 0..300 (100 = unchanged), "sure_when": conditions (read keys too) that make every leg's road fight sure, "road_encounters": [["encounter", weight 1..100]...]}]} (CAMPAIGN1-TM, campaign worlds only): the party picks one on the world map; meter inputs on legs may name the modes they count in. {} = no modes (the nearest parent world's).

world.label: Start sequence
world.help: A story sequence (STORYUI1) a new game in this world opens on (the intro, a prologue). Empty = the map, as before.

world.label: Class names
world.help: HOOKS1 CN1: {class_id: {"name": 1-32, "description": 0-240, "skill_path": {family: level 1-30}}}: the class's name, description and (when skill_path is set, {} allowed) path in this world; the nearest manifest in the lineage with a class id wins. {} = the base classes.

world.label: Roster
world.help: ROSTER1 11.1-11.2: {"bunks": 0 (party max) or 1..12, "bunks_flag": an int flag added to the bunks, "bunks_max": bunks..12 (12), "crypts": 0..12, "open_flag": the flag that opens roster management ("" = open), "rules": [at most 4 rows {"acts": [0..9] (empty = every act; only the last row), "bleed_out_rounds": 0..6, "hp_after": carry | full, "downed_won": classic | wounded, "downed_left", "downed_lost": classic | wounded | captured | dead, "standing_lost": classic | wounded, "wounded_max_hp_pct": 1..90 (20), "keepsakes_on": [captured, dead, lost]}], "keepsakes": {"on": [captured, dead, lost], "by_class": {class id: item id}, "name": "{name}'s {item}" (1-40 characters)}}. {} = today's rules: bunks = party max, no rule row (classic HEAL1), no keepsakes.

locations.help: [{"to": "location", "label": "north road"}]; `to` may be world:id to cross into a connected world.

locations.label: Tile set
locations.help: LOOK1: the region map's tile set (tilesets/<set>/ in the asset layers: floor, wall, wall_face, shallow_water, transition pieces, ground/<ground>, boundary/<name>). Empty = the world lineage's sets, then common. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores (2-32 characters); a warning when no layer holds tilesets/<set>/floor/v0.png or a ground/ folder.

locations.label: Boundary walls
locations.help: The map's outer walls: tilesets/<set>/boundary/<name>/wall and wall_face over the location's tile sets, their own art beside the set's inner walls. Empty = the set's own walls. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores (2-32 characters); a warning when no set holds it.

locations.label: Zone bindings
locations.help: {"zone_id": {"encounters": [["enc", 3]], "elites": [], "elite_pct": 10, "steps_min": 12, "steps_max": 20}} for DANGER zones of the map.

locations.label: Markers
locations.help: [{"id", "kind": exit|encounter|roamer|npc|chest|lore|point, "anchor", "label" (max 32), "note" (points only, max 160), "face" (npc only: down, the default, up, left or right), ...}] placed on the map's anchors (a roamer walks a path instead).

locations.label: World-map position
locations.help: [] = automatic layout, or [x, y] with each number 0..1 (0,0 top-left of the world map).

locations.label: Rest place

characters.label: Plays as (base unit)
characters.help: The Content Forge unit this character behaves as: vitals, class, loadout, skills and AI come from it.

characters.label: Art
characters.help: The body (ASSETORG2): a body key, <class> or <class>/<variant>; empty = the base unit's.

characters.label: Palette
characters.help: A palette of the body (ASSETORG2): the id of a file <body>/palettes/<id>.json; empty = none.

characters.label: Portrait tier
characters.help: Unique portrait (hero, npc, elite, boss: portraits/heroes, npcs, elites or bosses/<id>.png) or the body's common one; empty = auto (party hero, npc, an enemy by its base unit's tier).

characters.label: Disciplines
characters.help: Trained disciplines: each grants its passives.

characters.label: Passives
characters.help: Traits from the character's background (also granted: its faction's, its disciplines' and its named items').

characters.label: Temperament
characters.help: U4 temperament (ROSTER1-T, FB-29): an always-on passive (slot "") gathered right after the character's own passives, before its faction's, disciplines' and named items' (each id once); heroes too. Empty = none.

characters.label: Default intent
characters.help: FB-29: the round intent this character starts a battle in (rule round_intent), over its base unit's; empty = the base unit's.

characters.label: AI role
characters.help: FB-29: this character's AI role, over its base unit's and its class's; empty = the base unit's (else the class's).

characters.label: Named items
characters.help: Equipped on top of the base loadout, each in its own slot.

characters.label: Keepsake
characters.help: ROSTER1 KS2: a party character's keepsake, an accessory with value 0 and Special item set; the stash gets one when the member departs with a life the roster's keepsakes list (captured, dead, lost). Empty = none.

characters.label: Tuning deltas
characters.help: Explicit gameplay deltas vs the base unit: {"hp_pct": 10, "power": 3, "armor": 2, "speed": 1, "ap": 2}. Empty = identical to the base.

characters.label: Dialogue
characters.help: The tree shown when the party talks to this character. Empty = service choices only.

characters.label: Gone when
characters.help: [{"key": "flag.key", "value": true}]; ANY holding = the character is gone (no dialogue, no npc markers, shops closed).

characters.label: Overrides
characters.help: Qualified id (world:id) of an ancestor world's entry this one replaces. Everything that referred to it now refers to this entry.

characters.help: Free-form tags for searching and grouping.

items.label: Based on (base item)
items.help: The Content Forge item this is a named version of.

items.label: Tuning deltas
items.help: {"power": 2, "mitigation": 1, "burden": -1}. Empty = identical to the base item.

items.label: Wearer passives
items.help: Base passives granted while the item is worn by a character.

quests.label: Template
quests.help: QuestCatalog template id (objectives + generic rewards). Empty = lore-only quest; with a template, steps bind one per objective.

quests.label: Requires flags
quests.help: [{"key": "flag.key", "value": true}]; all must hold to start.

quests.label: Auto start
quests.help: Starts by itself once available (needs a template).

quests.label: Variants
quests.help: [{"id", "when_flags": [...], "unless_flags": [...], "set": {giver, turn_in, description, reward, rewards_from, steps, links, available, loot_pool, loot_picks}}], applied in order.

quests.label: Loot pool
quests.help: World loot refs offered as a pick on completion (on top of the generic rewards).

quests.label: Loot picks
quests.help: How many pool entries the player may take (0..3).

quests.label: Reputation
quests.help: {"faction": 10}: reputation deltas (-50..50, not 0, at most 4 factions) applied when the quest completes (needs a template).

quests.help: Qualified id (world:id) of an ancestor world's entry this one replaces. Everything that referred to it now refers to this entry.

quests.label: Tags
quests.help: Free-form tags for searching and grouping.

quests.label: Board
quests.help: A mission board (STORYUI1): the quest is listed and offered only there. Needs a template; the giver must be empty or the board's keeper.

quests.label: Track
quests.help: The board section of an available quest: main (Main) or side (Jobs).

quests.label: Show locked
quests.help: Listed on the board while locked, with the lock reason.

quests.label: Closed text
quests.help: At most 80 characters: while the quest is unavailable or blocked, the board lists it under Closed with this line. Empty = not listed.

encounters.label: Terrain rows
encounters.help: ENCOUNTER2 R0: [] = the zone's map; else 9 strings of 12 terrain glyphs, row 0 at the top (. floor, , grass, : dirt, o stone, s sand, * snow, ~ shallow water, W deep water, m mud, L lava, # wall, T tree, = bridge, r rubble, f burning ground, p toxic bog, i ice); they replace the zone's terrain, the zone still picks the backdrop and tiles.

encounters.label: Arena hazards
encounters.help: Rule arena_hazards (HOOKS1 AH1): up to 4 [{"id", "name", "cells": [[x, y]] | "columns": [x] | "rows": [y], "rounds": [] (every round), "blocks": [1-6], "effect": {"damage" | "damage_pct", "stagger", "status", "potency", "magnitude", "status_rounds", "push": {"dir", "tiles", "collide_damage"}}, "line"}] striking at the end of those blocks.

encounters.label: Start AP
encounters.help: Every unit's AP when the battle starts, at most its max (0 = full).

encounters.label: Phases
encounters.help: Boss phases (BOSS1): same shape as catalog encounters; refs are character refs (EncounterPhases). {"kind": "arrival", "round": 1, "block": 4}: a reinforcement wave that enters before that block, counts as an enemy from the start and holds one wave effect; at most one, listed first (PHASEFOLD). HOOKS1: an ai effect may set "tactics"; a deck effect {"type": "deck", "unit", "add", "order"} changes the unit's deck (rule deck in the world's ruleset); FX1: a shake effect {"type": "shake", "preset"} shakes the battle camera (jolt, heavy, toll, tremor or quake; at most one per phase). ENCOUNTER2-C: a round trigger may add "block" (0 = the round start, 1 to total_blocks = that block's start; round 1 fires before round 1 is planned); {"kind": "downed", "unit", "count": 1} is due once the count-th unit of the name is down and {"kind": "broken", "unit"} once one breaks (rule poise), each firing at the next block start or round start; the unit name is an encounter ref, "party" or "party:<id>". {"type": "talk", "dialogue", "speaker"} opens a dialogue tree of the world over the battle (at most one per phase; its effects only set_flag or add_flag; no rule reads it); a broken trigger needs the poise rule in the world's ruleset.

encounters.label: Scripted rounds
encounters.help: ENCOUNTER2-C scripted rounds (rule round_intent; [] = none): at most 3 [{"round": N (1..max_rounds, once), "lock": true (planned and confirmed at the round start, the input locked; false = a guided round: the enemies' entries fixed, the party's become first picks), "others": "auto" | "rest" (members with no entry: their auto plan, or Rest), "banner" (at most 40 characters), "entries": [{"unit": ref | ref#n | party:<id> | party#n, "target": "self" | a unit | [x, y], "picks": 1-4 of {"skill": family, "kind"?}, {"item": id} (party only), "rest", {"move": [x, y]} (first only), {"step_after": [x, y]}, "fill": "auto" | "rest"}] (1-16, one per unit)}]. Picked by the player's pick rules (AP, range, moves); a script never forces a hit; an entry that cannot be planned logs a Script cell and its unit plays its own round. Refs are character refs.

encounters.label: Pace
encounters.help: Round target tier (PACE1): auto = boss / elite / mob from the enemy tiers (EncounterPhases.pace_of).

encounters.label: Start buffs
encounters.help: [{"status", "rounds": 2, "magnitude": 0, "requires_flags": [{"key", "value"}], "text"}], at most 2 (PACE1 story rewards): a buff (not taunt or riposte) for every hero and guest at round 1 when the flags hold.

encounters.label: Objective
encounters.help: rout, hold, escape or slay (OBJ1; EncounterObjectives).

encounters.label: Objective tiles
encounters.help: [[x, y], ...] walkable, not exits; [] = the ring [[5, 4], [6, 4]].

encounters.label: Hold rounds
encounters.help: Hold only: round ends held to win (1..max rounds).

encounters.label: Slay target
encounters.help: A ref from Enemies.

encounters.label: Heroes out
encounters.help: Escape only: heroes that must leave by an exit.

encounters.label: Objective text
encounters.help: At most 80 characters; empty = generated from the objective.

encounters.label: Unkillable
encounters.help: ENCOUNTER2 S1: enemies (or phase-wave units) damage never takes below 1 HP; the first time it would, the log says "<name> will not fall here." (once per unit). Rout cannot end the fight while one stands.

encounters.label: Timeout outcome
encounters.help: ENCOUNTER2 S2: the verdict when the last round ends with none (fled = today's rule).

encounters.label: Stay behind
encounters.help: ENCOUNTER2 3 (escape only; {} = none): {"mode": "hold" | "stand", "tiles": [[x, y]] (hold: 1-2 walkable tiles, not exits; stand: none), "tiles_label": "the line" (1-24 characters), "fallback": "any" | "none" (hold), "pick_default": "highest_hp" | "first" (hold), "exits_open": "always" | "after_stand" (stand), "stand_hp_pct": 30 (stand, 1-100), "stand_statuses": [{"status": "taunt", "rounds": 5}] (at most 3, rounds 1-10), "stand_line", "result_line" (at most 160 characters, {name} the only token), "flag": a flag key set to the member who stayed, "then": "none" | "capture" | "kill" (ROSTER1 3.2)}. Hold: the player picks who holds the tiles before round 1; the exits open while the holder holds; won when enough heroes are out and every other one is out, down or holding.

encounters.label: Morale
encounters.help: Enemy groups break and surrender (MORALE1; EncounterMorale). Off = they fight to the last.

encounters.label: Morale break
encounters.help: Morale only: 0..90, a group is Broken at or below this value.

encounters.label: Morale leader
encounters.help: Morale only: a ref from Enemies; empty = the first boss or elite enemy, else none.

encounters.label: Morale groups
encounters.help: Morale only: [[enemy index, ...], ...]; every enemy in exactly one group; [] = one group.

encounters.label: Morale text
encounters.help: Morale only: at most 80 characters; empty = the generated break line.

encounters.label: Purse
encounters.help: {"gold_min": 0, "gold_max": gold_min, "once": true} (PURSE1, REWARD1): gold 0..500, split among the enemies by kill weight and paid per defeated enemy on any outcome; once = each enemy's share pays once per save. {} = no purse.

encounters.label: Key loot
encounters.help: [{"loot": "world loot id", "kill": "roster ref"}] (REWARD1): paid on a win in which every unit of that ref was killed (not surrendered, not fled); claimed once per save.

encounters.label: Objective reward
encounters.help: {"gold": 0, "loot": "", "once": true} (REWARD1): paid on a win (the objective done); gold 0..500, loot = a world loot id (item reward); once = the first win only. {} = none.

encounters.label: Guests
encounters.help: At most 2 party-side extras: party characters, or npcs whose base unit has side party.

encounters.label: Party min
encounters.help: ROSTER1 BK6: the fewest heroes the fight takes (0 = any; at most the world's party max); the fight and the battle start refuse with fewer in the party.

encounters.label: Protect
encounters.help: Guests that must survive (each must be in Guests).

dialogues.label: Start node

dialogues.label: Nodes
dialogues.help: [{"id", "speaker", "expression", "text", "choices": [{"text", "to", "requires", "unless", "effects", "show_locked"}], "effects", "next", "end"}]; a node has exactly one of choices, next or end; expression: "" or a face of portrait_expressions (or neutral) (the speaker's face on that node).

dialogues.label: Service choices
dialogues.help: Append the generated quest offer / turn-in / shop / farewell choices to the start node.

shops.label: Keeper
shops.help: The character who runs the shop (gone keeper = closed shop).

shops.label: Stock
shops.help: [{"item": "base item id", "count": -1, "price": -1, "requires_flags": []}]; count -1 = unlimited, price -1 = derived from the item value.

shops.label: Loot for sale
shops.help: [{"loot": "world loot ref", "price": 150}]; item loot only, sold once (claimed).

shops.label: Buy multiplier
shops.help: 0.5..3.0: derived buy price = ceil(value x mult).

shops.label: Supply price
shops.help: Gold per travel supply (fixed, unlimited, ignores multipliers and reputation); 0 = sells no supplies; 1..999.

shops.label: Sell multiplier
shops.help: 0.0..1.0: sell price = floor(value x mult); 0 = buys nothing.

shops.label: Buys types
shops.help: Item types the shop buys (every item type but QUEST by default; never QUEST).

shops.label: Open when
shops.help: [{"key", "value"}]; the shop is closed while any fails.

routes.label: From
routes.help: Where the route starts (a world map node).

routes.label: To
routes.help: Where it leads; may be world:id into a connected world.

routes.label: Fight zone
routes.help: Combat zone of road fights (empty = each encounter's own): one of the 8 code zones or a `zones` row id.

routes.label: Encounter chance %
routes.help: 0..100 per leg on the first traversal.

routes.label: Repeat chance %
routes.help: -1 = half the encounter chance (rounded down); else 0..100 per leg once traversed.

routes.label: Elites
routes.help: Same shape; the elite chance picks from these.

routes.label: Scripted fights
routes.help: [{"id", "encounter", "requires_flags", "unless_flags", "sets_flags"}], at most 4; one-shot, before the roll.

routes.label: Open when

routes.label: Closed when

meters.label: Kind
meters.help: gauge: a stored value in min..max; countdown: the days left on the travel clock once clock_start runs it.

meters.label: Max
meters.help: Highest value, above min (a countdown: 1..999 days, read while it is stopped).

meters.label: Start
meters.help: Value at a new game, in min..max.

meters.label: Unit
meters.help: Shown after the value on the HUD; a countdown needs days.

meters.label: Visible
meters.help: On the map HUD from the start (else after meter_show or clock_start); hidden meters still run.

meters.label: Scope
meters.help: campaign: one value for the run. unit (doctrine leans) is reserved for CAMPAIGN1-DOC.

meters.label: Bands
meters.help: [{"id", "name", "from", "tone": calm | warn | danger | fatal}], 1-6, ascending, the first from = min.

meters.label: Rules
meters.help: [{"id", "at": band id or value, "dir": up | down, "acts": [], "once", "warn", "effects", "then", "restart_days"}], at most 12; fire when the value crosses at.

meters.label: Inputs
meters.help: Gauges: [{"on": battle, "tags", "outcomes": won | lost | fled, "delta", "acts"} | {"on": day, "delta", "acts"} | {"on": leg, "route_tags", "modes" (travel mode ids, CAMPAIGN1-TM; empty = any), "delta", "acts"}], at most 12.

meters.label: Modifiers
meters.help: [{"bands", "road_pct", "road_encounters": [["encounter", weight]], "route_tags"}]: while a band holds, road fights on matching routes.

meters.label: Floors

checkpoints.label: Quest
checkpoints.help: Met when this quest is done. Set this or Met when, not both.

checkpoints.label: Met when
checkpoints.help: [{"key", "value", "op"}]: met when every condition holds (instead of a quest).

checkpoints.label: Warn days
checkpoints.help: Days left at which a warning shows: whole numbers 1..30, descending.

checkpoints.label: Missed
checkpoints.help: end_run: a miss ends the run with the card; go_on: a miss runs the effects and the story continues.

checkpoints.label: Bad-end card
checkpoints.help: The end card shown when a miss ends the run (end_run needs one).

checkpoints.label: Effects
checkpoints.help: Effects of a miss (go_on needs some): dialogue effects that need no screen and the campaign effects.

triggers.help: The cause it is checked after: any, a day passing, a settled battle, entering a location, an act change.

triggers.label: Encounter
triggers.help: On battle only: just this encounter (empty = any).

triggers.label: Outcome
triggers.help: On battle only: just this outcome.

triggers.label: Location
triggers.help: On enter only: just this location (empty = any).

triggers.label: When
triggers.help: [{"key", "value", "op"}]: every condition must hold (read keys such as meter.<id> included).

triggers.label: Once
triggers.help: Off = fires again each time When holds after it stopped holding.

triggers.label: Effects
triggers.help: Run at once: dialogue effects that need no screen and the campaign effects.

triggers.label: Then

triggers.label: Tags

vignettes.label: Music
vignettes.help: Empty = the music playing goes on; none = silence; else a track under the asset layers' audio/ ending .ogg (music/town.ogg).

vignettes.label: Skippable
vignettes.help: Off = the Skip control is hidden and refused.

vignettes.label: Once
vignettes.help: Queued by an effect or a trigger: not queued again once seen (a sequence plays it anyway).

vignettes.label: Cards
vignettes.help: 1-24 cards: [{"style": image | text | title | line, "image", "top", "bottom", "ash", "title" (48), "subtitle" (80), "text" (360; tokens {flag:KEY}, {member:KEY}), "speaker", "expression" (line cards: "" or a face of portrait_expressions (or neutral)), "fade_in_ms" (600), "fade_out_ms" (400), "hold_ms" (0 = waits for a click), "cue", "shake" ("" or a camera shake: jolt, heavy, toll, tremor, quake; starts with the card's fade in), "when": [conditions]}].

vignettes.label: Overrides
vignettes.help: Qualified id (world:id) of an ancestor world's entry this one replaces. Everything that referred to it now refers to this entry.

vignettes.label: Tags

sequences.label: Steps
sequences.help: 1-40 steps: {"kind": "vignette", "vignette"} | {"kind": "fight", "encounter", "on_lost", "on_fled": retry | abort | continue} | {"kind": "effects", "effects": [1-8]} | {"kind": "enter", "location", "anchor"} | {"kind": "end", "to": map | menu}; enter and end only last.
